####################################################################################################
Purpose of script: To check the convergence and WAIC of the models 
####################################################################################################

```{r}
rm(list = ls())
source("../00_pck.R")
library(colorspace)
theme_set(theme_classic() + theme(strip.background = element_blank()))
dirs$figures <- "../figures"
```

# Translate mod name to corresponding variables 
```{r}
df_modtovar <- data.frame(mod = list.files(glue("{dirs$rhats}"))) %>%
  mutate(mod = str_remove_all(mod, "rhats_"),
         modtemp = str_remove_all(mod, ".rds"),
         vac = case_when(str_detect(modtemp, "bmvl") ~ "l", 
                         str_detect(modtemp, "bmv1") ~ "1"),
         modtemp = str_remove_all(modtemp, paste0("bmv",vac,"_")),
         mod_out = case_when(str_detect(modtemp, "spos") ~ "spos",
                             .default = "imm"),
         modtemp = str_remove_all(modtemp, "spos_"),
         dat = case_when(str_detect(modtemp, "seonlytemp_s08") ~ "seonlytemp_s08",
                         str_detect(modtemp, "semeth_s08") ~ "semeth_s08",
                         .default = "s08"),
         modtemp = str_remove_all(modtemp, paste0(dat, "_")),
         gauss = case_when(str_detect(modtemp, "gauss") ~ "gauss", 
                           .default = "gamma"),
         modtemp = str_remove_all(modtemp, paste0("_", gauss)),
         mod_name = case_when(str_detect(modtemp, "base") ~ "base",
                              str_detect(modtemp, "csi_reg_2") ~ "csi_reg_2",
                              str_detect(modtemp, "csi_reg_3") ~ "csi_reg_3",
                              str_detect(modtemp, "csi_reg_4") ~ "csi_reg_4",
                              str_detect(modtemp, "csi_reg_6") ~ "csi_reg_6",
                              str_detect(modtemp, "cs") ~ "cs"),
         modtemp = str_remove_all(modtemp, paste0("_", mod_name)),
         pat = modtemp
         ) %>%
  select(mod, pat, mod_out, mod_name, dat, vac, gauss) %>%
  left_join(pat_tidy_names, by = join_by(pat))
```


# Check convergence (Rhats) of the photoperiod models ==============================================
```{r}
# Check that Rhats < 1
rhats <- pomp::bake(glue("{dirs$outputs}/all_rhats.rds"), dir = "", {
  bind_rows(lapply(str_subset(list.files(glue("{dirs$rhats}"), full.names = TRUE), 
                                     "all|archiv", negate = TRUE), readRDS)) %>%
  group_by(mod) %>%
  filter(Rhat == max(Rhat)) %>%
  mutate(Rhat = round(Rhat, digits = 1),
         Rhat_cond = Rhat == 1) %>%
  select(mod, Rhat_cond)
})

rhats %>%
  filter(Rhat_cond == FALSE)
```

# Check which coefficients were problematic for models with Rhats > 1 
```{r}
check <- FALSE
if(check) {
# Check which coefficients were problematic for models with Rhats > 1 
bind_rows(lapply(filter(rhats, Rhat_cond == FALSE)$mod, 
                 function(x) readRDS(glue("{dirs$rhats}/rhats_{x}")))) %>%
  mutate(Rhat = round(Rhat, digits = 1)) %>%
  filter(Rhat != 1) %>%
  select(mod, coefficient, Rhat) %>%
    distinct(mod)
}
```

# Check WAIC of the photoperiod models =============================================================
```{r}
# Read in the waic of the models that converged
waic_df <- pomp::bake(glue("{dirs$outputs}/all_waic.rds"), dir = "", {
  bind_rows(lapply(list.files(glue("{dirs$waic}"), full.names = TRUE), readRDS)) %>%
  select(mod, Estimate_waic) %>%
  rename(waic = Estimate_waic) %>%
  left_join(df_modtovar, by = join_by(mod)) %>%
  left_join(rhats, by = join_by(mod)) %>%
  filter(Rhat_cond)
})

waic_df %>%
  arrange(pat, waic) %>%
  group_by(pat, mod_out, dat) %>%
  mutate(delta_waic = waic - waic[1])
```

# Check waic table per pathogen, data, and model output
```{r}
waic_l <- sapply(unique(waic_df$pat), function(x) filter(
  waic_df, pat == x, dat == "s08", mod_out == "imm"), simplify = FALSE)
waic_l$rota
```

# Main analysis ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Check best for each pathogen
```{r}
# Simple best for each pathogen
waic_best <- waic_df %>%
  group_by(pat) %>%
  filter(dat == "s08", mod_out == "imm") %>%
  mutate(waic_base = waic[mod_name == "base"]) %>%
  arrange(pat, waic) %>%
  mutate(waic_best = waic[1]) %>%
  mutate(delta_waic = waic_base - waic_best) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  select(pat, mod, mod_out, delta_waic, waic_base, waic_best, everything())
waic_best

# Check minimum best waic for each pathogen
waic_minbest <- waic_df %>%
  group_by(pat) %>%
  filter(dat == "s08", mod_out == "imm") %>%
  mutate(waic_base = waic[mod_name == "base"]) %>%
  arrange(pat, mod_name) %>%
  mutate(delta_waic = waic - waic_base,
         better_waic = delta_waic < 2) %>%
  select(pat, mod_name, mod_out, waic, delta_waic, better_waic, everything()) %>%
  filter(better_waic) %>%
  slice_tail() %>%
  ungroup()
waic_minbest

# Save minimum best waic for each pathogen
saveRDS(waic_minbest, glue("{dirs$outputs}/all_waic_minbest.rds"))
```

# Plot waic comparisons 
```{r}
pl_waic <- waic_df %>%
  filter(dat == "s08", mod_out == "imm") %>%
  arrange(pat, waic) %>%
  group_by(pat, mod_out, dat) %>%
  mutate(delta_waic = waic - waic[1]) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = delta_waic, y = mod_name, color = mod_name)) +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 2), color = "grey", linetype = "dotted") + 
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    geom_segment(aes(xend = 0, yend = mod_name), size = 2.5, alpha = 0.3) + 
    scale_x_continuous("Delta WAIC (log10)", trans = "log10") + 
    scale_color_manual(values = c("black", "grey", "red","red", "red", "red")) +
    facet_wrap(pat_tidy~., scales = "free_y", ncol = 5) + 
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          axis.title.y = element_blank()) 

pl_waic
ggsave(pl_waic, file = glue("{dirs$figures}/mod_waic.pdf"), height = 7, width = 11)
```

# Figure 2 =========================================================================================

# Plot for only main pathogens
```{r}
pat_sel <- c("rota", "hav", "hbv", "dipht", "tetan", "pertuwpt", "ipv1", 
             "hib", "menc", "strep04", "measl", "mumps", "rubel", "vzv")
```

# Prepare predictions data for the plot 
```{r}
pred_l <- sapply(filter(waic_minbest, pat %in% pat_sel)$mod, function(x) {
  # Get model information
  waic_mod <- waic_df[waic_df$mod == x, ]
  # Read in data from the model 
  dat <- readRDS(paste0(dirs$modfit, "/data_brms_", waic_mod$pat[[1]], "_v", waic_mod$vac[[1]], 
                        "_s08.rds"))
  # Tidy mod_reg 
  mod_reg <- if(str_detect(waic_mod$mod_name[[1]], "reg")) str_remove(waic_mod$mod_name[[1]], "csi_")
  # Read in 20 predictions from the model 
  as.data.frame(t(readRDS(glue("{dirs$pred}/pred_{x}")))) %>%
      select(1:20) %>%
      bind_cols(data.frame(
        data = dat$imm_val_s1,
        imm_cutoff_s1 = dat$imm_cutoff_s1,
        imm_cutoff_min = min(dat$imm_val_s1),
        reg = if(!is.null(mod_reg)) dat[,mod_reg][[1]] else NA
      )) %>%
      pivot_longer(-c(reg, imm_cutoff_s1, imm_cutoff_min)) %>%
      mutate(type = case_when(name == "data" ~ "2data", .default = "1draw"))
    }, simplify = FALSE)

# Separate in two data frames
preddf_l <- lapply(list(1:7,8:14), function(x) {
  bind_rows(pred_l[str_subset(names(pred_l), paste(pat_sel[x], collapse = "|"))], .id = "mod") %>%
    left_join(distinct(waic_df, mod, pat, pat_tidy), by = join_by(mod)) %>% 
    mutate(name_draw = paste0(name,reg)) 
})
```

# Prepare waic data for the plot 
```{r}
waic_pldf <- waic_df %>%
  filter(pat %in% pat_sel, dat == "s08", mod_out == "imm") %>%
  mutate(mod_name = factor(mod_name, labels = c(
    "Base", "Seasonal", "Seasonal by latitude (2)" , "Seasonal by latitude (3)",
    "Seasonal by latitude (4)", "Seasonal by latitude (6)"))) %>%
  group_by(pat) %>%
  arrange(waic) %>%
  mutate(delta_waic = waic - waic[1]) %>%
  mutate(waic_base = delta_waic[mod_name == "Base"]) %>%
  mutate(delta_waic = case_when(delta_waic < 0.5 ~ 0.5, .default = delta_waic))

# Separate in two data frames
waic_pldf_l <- lapply(list(1:7,8:14), function(x) filter(waic_pldf, pat %in% pat_sel[x]))
```

# WAIC plot
```{r}
fig2a <- lapply(waic_pldf_l, function(x) {
  x %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = delta_waic, y = mod_name, color = mod_name)) +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = waic_base + 2), color = "grey") + 
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    geom_segment(aes(xend = 0.5, yend = mod_name), size = 2.5, alpha = 0.3) + 
    scale_x_continuous("Delta WAIC from Base model", trans = "log2") + 
    scale_color_viridis_d(option = "rocket", end = 0.8) + 
    facet_wrap(pat_tidy~., ncol = 1) + 
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          axis.title.y = element_blank())
})
```

# Predictions plot 
```{r}
fig2b <- lapply(preddf_l, function(x) {
  x %>%
    filter(type == "1draw") %>%
    mutate(value = case_when(pat != "rota" & value <= imm_cutoff_s1 ~ imm_cutoff_min, 
                             pat == "rota" & value <= 20 ~ 20, 
                             , .default = value)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = value, group = name_draw, color = as.character(reg))) + 
    geom_line(stat = "ecdf", alpha = 0.1) + 
    geom_line(data = filter(x, type == "2data") %>%
                mutate(value = case_when(pat != "rota" & value <= imm_cutoff_s1 ~ imm_cutoff_min, 
                                         pat == "rota" & value <= 20 ~ 20, .default = value)), 
              stat = "ecdf", linetype = "dashed") +  
    facet_wrap(~pat_tidy, scales = "free", ncol = 1) +
    #facet_wrap(~pat_tidy, scales = "free") +
    scale_x_continuous("Immunogenicity (log10)", trans = "log10") + 
    scale_color_viridis_d("", option = "mako", na.value = "grey50", begin = 0, end = 0.8) + 
    theme(legend.position = "none")
})
```

# Patch plots together 
```{r}
fig2 <- fig2a[[1]] + fig2b[[1]] + fig2a[[2]] + fig2b[[2]] + plot_layout(ncol = 4, widths = c(1,1,1,1))

# Save the plot 
ggsave(glue("{dirs$figures}/fig2.pdf"), width = 12, height = 10)
```
